get.description: List all persons.
Get a person by ID.
Get all aliases for a person.
Get persecution classification for a person.
Events linked to a Person, each with its source article span.
Person card data: aliases, classifications, RF status and evidence-backed events.
Full ParsedArticle text for evidence inspection.
List politically persecuted persons absent from Rosfinmonitoring.
List Rosfinmonitoring snapshots.
Get a Rosfinmonitoring snapshot by ID.
List entries in a Rosfinmonitoring snapshot.
Running and latest monitoring runs, source checkpoints, active findings.
One run with its counters, stage metrics and failed items.
Liveness (kept for compatibility; prefer /health/live).
The process answers. Never checks dependencies.
Database and schema are required; monitoring is reported.

The build this instance runs, the document and person totals, the last
successful operator run.

Publications, people, the result, the operator's queue, the latest monitoring run,
the step running now and the next thing to do.

The people of the publications with a criminal case, as the legacy «Все люди» lists
them: the same filters, the same order, a hundred a page.

The publications with a criminal case, newest first, searched by title and text and
filtered by source; each with its people and events.

The people an article names and the events found in it, as the legacy article
page shows them above the text.

The people with a political criminal case, latest news first, as the legacy
«Результат» lists them. Dates (day/month/year or ISO) win over the months. Unlike the
legacy page, filters are not remembered: the address is the state. A `queue` keeps
only the period and takes the queue's own filters; the queues' counts are of the
period, whatever queue is open.

post.description: Tick or untick «обработано»: a ticked person leaves the list until a later news.

get.description:
By any form of the name, the most mentioned first; with no name, the latest
political cases. Fifty at most, as on the legacy page.
The dossier of one person, as the legacy page reads it.

The sentences a model read from the publications, folded into cases, newest first;
`view=hidden` lists the rows a person took out of every count.
The people step 4 could not place, most mentioned first.

post.description: A person's word on a role: applied at once and kept for every rebuild.

get.description: The cases step 5 could not judge, most mentioned first.

post.description: A person's word on a case's politics: applied at once and kept for every rebuild.

get.description:
Two entities that may be one person, fifty a page; `key` brings that person's
pairs first.

post.description: «same»: one person, merged now and at every rebuild; «different»: off the list.

get.description:
What «Работа» shows: the first review to do, the other non-empty queues, and the
state of the five automatic steps.

post.description:
«Сделать всё»: the current step and, after it, every step to the end of the round.
409 when a run is live, when `after` is not the latest run any more (an old press),
or when another worker started first.

«Остановить»: the run, or the step its chain started after it ended a moment ago.
What was done stays.

get.description:
The legacy `/ui/candidates` table: the newest snapshot unless one is named; news of
the last 45 days unless `date_from` says otherwise (empty: every day).
One tab of «Безымянные», as the legacy page shows it.

post.description: «Вернуть на разбор»: back to the cards, whom the search set aside.
«Не он» of a candidate; with `undo`, taken back.
«Это он», «Подходящей записи РФМ нет», «Недостаточно данных».
«Отменить решение».

get.description: One tab of «Без имени в базе», as the legacy page shows it.

post.description: «Это он», «Не он» or «Отменить» («clear») of a candidate.

get.description:
One list of «Отсев», as the legacy page shows it; without a status, the one with
work in it.

post.description: «Мусор»: the next purge deletes it.
«Мусор — все»: every one, or none when one is no longer held.
«Это дело — в работу».
«Мусор» of a released article: back under the purge.
«Вернуть на проверку» of an article marked junk.
«Извлечь заново»: an event found returns the article to work.

get.description: The question `q`, or the latest one.

post.description: Ask a model; up to twenty seconds, in a thread so the other pages do not wait.

get.description: The legacy «База Airtable»: the lists, where they come from, the published list.

post.description: The four lists into PostgreSQL, as `POST /api/admin/airtable/sync`.

Download the published list, a new snapshot only if it changed, and check every
person against it again: the `check-entities-rosfin` run, in the background.

get.description: The officials list as it stands, and the people the model calls officials.

AboutResponse.title: AboutResponse
AboutResponse.description:
«О системе»: the build stamp, the totals behind the status strip, and the last
successful operator run. The same data the legacy `/ui/about` page shows.

AirtableOverviewResponse.title: AirtableOverviewResponse
AirtableOverviewResponse.description: «База Airtable»: whether a sync can run and how, the lists, the published list.

AirtableSyncResponse.title: AirtableSyncResponse
AirtableSyncResponse.description:
The whole sync: success, partial (some list failed) or failed. `mode` says
whether the records came from the Airtable API or from exported files.

AirtableTableSyncResponse.title: AirtableTableSyncResponse
AirtableTableSyncResponse.description:
One list's outcome. `error` is set only when that list itself failed, so the
other three still report what they did; `status` is `skipped` when the operator
exported no file for it, which leaves the list alone rather than emptying it.

ArticleMentionsResponse.title: ArticleMentionsResponse
ArticleMentionsResponse.description: The people an article names, most mentioned first, and the events found in it.

AskAnswerResponse.title: AskAnswerResponse
AskAnswerResponse.description: A question asked, its answer and the counts it stands on.

AskPageResponse.title: AskPageResponse
AskPageResponse.description:
«Спросить»: the day's spending, the examples, the chosen answer and the questions
asked before.

BaseUnnamedCandidateResponse.title: BaseUnnamedCandidateResponse
BaseUnnamedCandidateResponse.description: An entry of the list that may be a nameless record of the base.

BaseUnnamedCardResponse.title: BaseUnnamedCardResponse
BaseUnnamedCardResponse.description: A nameless record of the operator's base and who on the list it may be.

CandidateRowResponse.title: CandidateRowResponse
CandidateRowResponse.description: A row of the candidates' table, as the legacy page and its Excel file have it.

CandidateTableResponse.title: CandidateTableResponse
CandidateTableResponse.description:
The candidates under the legacy page's filters, in its order; the Excel file of the
same filters holds every one of `total`.

CycleResponse.title: CycleResponse
CycleResponse.description:
«Работа»: the one review to do first, the other queues, and the automatic steps
with the one press that runs what is left of the round.

CycleStartRequest.title: CycleStartRequest
CycleStartRequest.description: «Сделать всё»: the steps from the current one to the end of the round.

CycleTaskResponse.title: CycleTaskResponse
CycleTaskResponse.description: A manual queue of «Работа»: what waits for the operator and where.

DoneRequest.title: DoneRequest
DoneRequest.description: «обработано» on a person of «Результат»: ticked or not.

DossierKnownResponse.title: DossierKnownResponse
DossierKnownResponse.description: What the operator's base says, by the name alone; `loaded` False: no base to ask.

DossierResponse.title: DossierResponse
DossierResponse.description:
The legacy dossier: who, the system's decisions with their reasons and quotes, the
list, the charges, the timeline and the publications behind each conclusion.

EntityArticleResponse.title: EntityArticleResponse
EntityArticleResponse.description:
A Criminal Code article of a person; `shared` when every event naming it accuses
other people too.

EntityListResponse.title: EntityListResponse
EntityListResponse.description: One page of «Все люди» under the filters, with the counts the legacy page shows.

HeldArticleResponse.title: HeldArticleResponse
HeldArticleResponse.description: An article the junk screen held back from the purge.

HeldStoryResponse.title: HeldStoryResponse
HeldStoryResponse.description: Articles that seem to tell one story; one article alone is a story of one.

InvestigationSearchResponse.title: InvestigationSearchResponse
InvestigationSearchResponse.description: «Найти человека»: by any form of the name, or the latest political cases.

JunkHoldsResponse.title: JunkHoldsResponse
JunkHoldsResponse.description: «Отсев»: one list of held articles, a page of its stories, and every list's count.

KnownResponse.title: KnownResponse
KnownResponse.description: What the operator's base says of a person.

LiveOperationResponse.title: LiveOperationResponse
LiveOperationResponse.description: The step running now: its mode and the title the console gives it.

OfficialsResponse.title: OfficialsResponse
OfficialsResponse.description: The officials list kept by hand, and the model's suggestions for it.

OptionResponse.title: OptionResponse
OptionResponse.description:
One choice of a filter: its value, the console's words and, where the list counts
it, how many rows it would show.

PairListResponse.title: PairListResponse
PairListResponse.description: «Пары»: two entities that may be one person, for the operator to decide.

PoliticalListResponse.title: PoliticalListResponse
PoliticalListResponse.description: «Результат» under the filters: one page of rows and every count the filters show.

QueueResponse.title: QueueResponse
QueueResponse.description: What waits for the operator, by queue; `total` is the menu's «Работа» count.

QuoteResponse.title: QuoteResponse
QuoteResponse.description:
An excerpt with the mention or the event's trigger at [start, end); the article
text offsets open the full text with the same mark.

ReferenceListResponse.title: ReferenceListResponse
ReferenceListResponse.description: One reference list: what PostgreSQL holds of it and what it is read from.

ReviewListResponse.title: ReviewListResponse
ReviewListResponse.description: A review station: the people a step could not decide, and the operator's choices.

SentenceListResponse.title: SentenceListResponse
SentenceListResponse.description: «Приговоры» under the filters, or (`view=hidden`) what was taken out.

SentenceRowResponse.title: SentenceRowResponse
SentenceRowResponse.description:
One case of «Приговоры» (several rows of one sentence told by several sources), or
one row a person took out of the counts.

StatusResponse.title: StatusResponse
StatusResponse.description: The legacy status strip and menu counters: the same numbers on every page.

UnnamedActionRequest.title: UnnamedActionRequest
UnnamedActionRequest.description:
A word on an unnamed figurant; the fields the action needs, as the legacy form
sends them.

UnnamedBaseCandidateResponse.title: UnnamedBaseCandidateResponse
UnnamedBaseCandidateResponse.description: A person of the operator's base who may be the unnamed figurant.

UnnamedCardResponse.title: UnnamedCardResponse
UnnamedCardResponse.description:
One unnamed figurant: the sentence, what it tells, the operator's word and the
candidates from the list, other publications and the base.

UnnamedListResponse.title: UnnamedListResponse
UnnamedListResponse.description: «Безымянные»: one tab of cards, the tabs' counts, and the searches' answers.

UnnamedNamedCandidateResponse.title: UnnamedNamedCandidateResponse
UnnamedNamedCandidateResponse.description: A named figurant of another publication who may be the unnamed one.

UnnamedRfCandidateResponse.title: UnnamedRfCandidateResponse
UnnamedRfCandidateResponse.description: An entry of the list that may be the unnamed figurant.

UnnamedScreenedResponse.title: UnnamedScreenedResponse
UnnamedScreenedResponse.description: Whom the search set aside on its own.
